children: Charles Schwab Corp (NYSE:SCHW) expanded crypto trading to include Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink with a 0.75% fee and near‑nationwide access while also raising its Schwab Advisor Network referral minimum to $5M and facing market pressure after Vanguard’s Altruist deal news weighed on the stock.
Charles Schwab Corp Adds Solana, Avalanche, Chainlink
: Charles Schwab (SCHW) added Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to its Schwab Crypto lineup alongside Bitcoin and Ethereum. Trades carry a 0.75% fee; more tokens will be added over time.
: SCHW fell >2% in morning trading after Vanguard said it will buy fintech custodian Altruist, which serves 6,000+ advisors. Deal to close later this year; terms not disclosed.
: Charles Schwab (SCHW) will charge a 0.75% flat fee on each crypto trade, offer crypto trading across all U.S. states except NY and LA, via a unified Schwab trading interface.
Schwab Advisor Network Referral Threshold Up
: Charles Schwab (SCHW) will raise the Schwab Advisor Network referral minimum from $2M to $5M next year; prior hike moved the threshold from $500K to $2M.
: Charles Schwab (SCHW) expanded its Employee Choice Grants, directing $1M to 84 nonprofits (avg ~$12K each) from 1,400 nominations. SCHW shares traded near $108.11, down ~3.7% midweek.
